verdict.rationale: Gecko Security is a commercial AI vulnerability-scanning service, and publishing its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows a public source repository or an open license. The hybrid deployment pulls digest-pinned container images and the pricing page offers self-hosting, but neither means the source is readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
